title: PROFINET IO
summary: PROFINET IO is an Industrial Ethernet standard from PI. An IO controller (PLC) exchanges cyclic data with IO devices that it identifies by device name.

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: Devices are identified by a **device name** assigned during commissioning; the controller assigns the IP address. Cyclic real-time data is exchanged at the configured update time; alarms and diagnostics are acyclic. Topology information (neighbors, ports) supports device replacement without an engineering tool.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Device name missing or duplicated, wrong device type or firmware in the configuration, topology mismatch, watchdog timeouts caused by network load or bad cabling.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
